title: Inside Pope Leo XIV's plane
subhead: Pope Leo XIV's visit to France, from September 25 to 28, marks the first official state visit by a pope in 18 years. On a specially chartered plane from Rome, he will be accompanied by 80 journalists. The trip follows a highly codified ritual, during which reporters who are practicing Catholics sometimes step outside their professional role.
